title: The cheers died away in the soft grey air.
html_source:
This makes the audience question whether or not Stephen’s moment of praise actually happened. It seems as if it may have been just a fantasy or a dream of Stephen’s.

anchor.text: The cheers died away in the soft grey air.
anchor.prefix:
ning up and crying:

 —Hurroo!

 And they gave three groans for Baldyhead Dolan and three cheers for Conmee and they said he was the decentest rector that was ever in Clongowes.
anchor.suffix: He was alone. He was happy and free: but he would not be anyway proud with Father Dolan. He would be very quiet and obedient: and he wished that he could do something kind for him
anchor.canonical_text: The cheers died away in the soft grey air.
